name: Logo drops onto the floor
summary: End card: the brand logo falls onto the world floor as a real 3D decal, lands with a flash and sparks, then eyebrow, tagline, and CTA button spring in. Falls back to a wordmark when the brand has no logo file.

params.worldWidth: logo width in world units (defaults to 62% of frame.floorSpan)
params.center: [x, y] landing point on the floor
params.spin: degrees of yaw during the fall
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

changelog: v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
